newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for Italy CCTs and BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for Italy CCTs and BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 148 billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.

Specialists also bid for 208 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTPs) against an offer of 150 billion lire of paper, and for 253 billion lire of 30-year BTPs against an offer of 200 billion lire.

On CCTs, the Treasury earlier today received bids for 6.645 trillion lire at the open auction for the May 1, 2004 paper, against two trillion lire worth of certificates on offer. The auction price was set at 99.00 from 99.20 at the previous CCT sale on May 15.

For 10-year BTPs, the Treasury received bids for 3.021 trillion lire for the February 1, 2007 paper against an offer of 1.5 trillion lire. The auction price was set at 97.00 from 97.70 at the previous auction on May 17.

For 30-year BTPs, the Treasury received bids for 3.089 trillion lire of the November 1, 2026 paper against an offer of 2.000 trillion lire. The auction price was set at 93.20 from 90.25 at the previous auction on April 29.
